The terminal tool has been failing to connect to the sandbox for over 20 minutes. This is a tool-side issue (it's trying to connect to the Podman socket via an SSH-like mechanism and failing). The sandbox itself was working fine until just recently — my last successful command showed that all three dev servers had started up and were in watch mode.

The installation itself is effectively complete:
- Toolchain installed (Node 24.16.0, pnpm 11.5.3, just 1.59.0, JDK 21)
- `just up --detach` completed: all 10 infrastructure containers + proxy are running, backend is healthy, database is seeded (events=11, news=10, poi=35), Keycloak realm swcode is up, all URLs were displayed
- `just serve`: all three dev servers (app, cms, boards) built and are serving (cms on :35581, boards on :38377, app in watch mode)

The only thing I wasn't able to do was the final HTTP smoke test on all three frontends via the proxy (the first request to the app server takes time for on-demand compilation and hangs, and after that the tool lost connection to the sandbox).

Let me try a few more times — the connection might recover. If it doesn't, I'll report based on the evidence gathered so far.
